convert_fine_tune_checkpoint: convert a fine-tuned PyTorch checkpoint to a release-ready checkpoint by merging backbone and heads from the starting checkpoint
run_convert_cli: run the CLI to convert a fine-tuned checkpoint and optional YAML config to release format
convert_checkpoint_with_yaml: convert a fine-tuned checkpoint and its YAML config to release format by removing finetune_config and copying backbone
convert_data_only_finetune: convert a data-only fine-tuned checkpoint that lacks heads config by copying heads from the starting checkpoint
review_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint: review the convert_fine_tune_checkpoint function to understand how it merges starting checkpoint backbone and heads into a fine-tuned checkpoint
